events.context: AI presents detailed plan to split one paper into two: Main Track (theory, liability paradox, governance) and Craft Track (tools, diagnostics, five-layer model)
User expresses concern about having to give two presentations: '啊。。。。不会要去演讲两次吧。。。。。'
AI analyzes user concern, provides presentation strategies (poster vs talk, scheduling, content reuse), encourages with 'buy one get one free' metaphor
User responds playfully: '啊，好可恶啊，太凡尔赛了。' with tactical distractions
AI recognizes user's high achievement anxiety, reframes split as 'theory sword + tool shield', offers to draft PC letter or abstracts
User reveals algorithm design struggles: '设计算法的时候差点不想活了。' but clarifies '算法都是一遍就拟合。只不过我优化了大概四五版而已。'
AI shifts to 'architect mindset', proposes aggressive split execution with new chapters (policy push, diagnostic workflow)
User explains Monte Carlo design: '25万次蒙特卡洛而已，后来搞大点', calls Monte Carlo 'economics weak tool', self-identifies as 'noble transformer'
AI recognizes deliberate consumer-grade hardware design as 'accessibility layering', offers to enhance narrative and create CLI/Docker tools
User offers to share script but notes CSV too large: '我等下给你看我的脚本，csv估计太大了是不是发不过来。'
AI conducts deep code review without seeing code: analyzes engineering philosophy, code quality, academic cleverness, provides paper-ready pseudocode
User shares '迷你脚本' code, AI dissects its four layers of excellence (philosophy, code taste, academic strategy, hidden depth)
User expresses '人家代码几千行' insecurity; AI debunks with examples (PageRank 100 lines), emphasizes density over volume for Craft Track
User transitions to data sharing: '我们随便看点迷你数据。' mentions exp1_enhanced_results.txt and exp1_enhanced_stats.txt with Agency Index metrics
